findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_funds, get_leaderboard · Private data: list_pe_firms, get_pe_firm, get_investor, list_founders · Public sink: list_funds, get_leaderboard.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_funds, get_leaderboard · Private data: list_pe_firms, get_pe_firm, get_investor, list_founders · Public sink: list_funds, get_leaderboard

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
